name: Verb wildcard ec2:Terminate* (boundary)
note: A partial wildcard on a destructive verb (ec2:Terminate*) must still trip DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION via the leading-verb match, while remaining below the WILDCARD-ACTION threshold (not a full "service:*"). The Resource arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:111122223333:instance/* is a resource-TYPE-prefixed wildcard - a concrete type head (instance) followed by a leading-wildcard identifier - so it reaches EVERY instance in the account/region, exactly as broad as role/* reaches every role. That is a broad, non-read (destructive) grant, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE (high) MUST also fire at the raw rule layer (exactFindingIds), where it is then folded into the same-statement DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION capability by IAM-201 correlation, so the correlated analyze() view (findingIds) shows DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION with WILDCARD-RESOURCE subsumed (S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 3: type-prefixed leading-wildcard identifiers are account-wide, not scoped).
